items.text: Every rebuild sends a request. Stopping listening cancels nothing, since
has no cancel method: the old request runs to the end and its result is ignored.
If a response takes longer than the gap between two rebuilds, no result is ever shown. Each future is replaced before it completes.
While it waits, the snapshot keeps the previous data (the docs say data and error "will be retained" when you switch to another future). A builder that checks
first shows no flicker, so on a fast network the bug is invisible.
